root_cause_1.wall: w4-clang b2: libc++ -fno-exceptions nothrow-operator-new override assert (brk #1 / EC=0x3C) in-OS
root_cause_1.mechanism: HobbyOS libc.a embeds src/libc/src/cxxrt.o with STRONG operator new/delete in plain .text (documented OS design). A toolchain link pulls that member for __cxa_atexit/__dso_handle (libc++abi cxa_atexit.cpp deliberately not built), so its strong _Znwm beats libc++ new.o's WEAK section-attributed _Znwm and lands OUTSIDE the __lcxx_override section -> libc++'s runtime check __is_function_overridden<&operator new> (new.cpp nothrow path) sees an 'overridden' function -> assert -> brk #1.
root_cause_1.evidence_for: pre-fix clang-21: _Znwm T 0x100484e410 (.text) vs section [0x1004866cc0,..); _Znwm body byte-identical to cxxrt.o's (malloc+over-align+cxxrt_oom), NOT libc++'s operator_new_impl; all four toolchain ELFs affected; NPNEW control unaffected (never pulls cxxrt.o).
root_cause_1.fix: src/user/toolchain/sysroot-headers/cxxrt_shim.cpp + closure edit in src/user/toolchain/cmake/toolchain-llvm-hobbyos.cmake (commits d2aab3d): shim heads the closure, strong section("__lcxx_override") operator new/new[] + __cxa_atexit/__cxa_finalize/__dso_handle (+placement forms + cxxrt_oom) so lld never extracts cxxrt.o. Fail-safe: any future cxxrt.o pull collides strong-vs-strong -> loud link error.

root_cause_2.wall: second in-OS data abort surfaced once wall 1 was fixed: free(BLOCK_MAGIC)
root_cause_2.mechanism: shim operator delete -> tc_free_aligned(p) -> free([p-8]); clang deletes memory from libc++'s operator new(std::nothrow), whose -fno-exceptions path returns a RAW std::malloc payload (no stash), so [p-8] == the block's own BLOCK_MAGIC -> free(BLOCK_MAGIC=0x48424F424C4B4D47) -> data abort (VA=0x48424F424C4B4D3F).
root_cause_2.evidence_for: gdb-multiarch over QEMU gdbstub, conditional breakpoint on free entry, latched x0==BLOCK_MAGIC: x0=0x48424f424c4b4d47 x30=0x10047d8708 (tc_free_aligned, cxxrt_shim.cpp) frame->0x10047d86c8 (operator delete(void*)) [evidence-w5-nothrow/gdb-free-caller.txt]. Serial: [KERNEL] pid=4 (/TOOLS/CLANG3.BIN) memory fault VA=0x48424F424C4B4D3F PC=0x100484C804 rw=r in=HOLE -> killed [t24-wall2-freemagic.serial.txt].
root_cause_2.fix: commit 7b2607a: shim delete delegates to free(ptr) (HobbyOS free() natively distinguishes stashed [p-8]=raw vs raw [p-8]=BLOCK_MAGIC payloads), mirroring libc++ delete.cpp.

os_wide_followup: src/libc/src/cxxrt.cpp's operator new/delete lack the __lcxx_override section attribute AND use the stash-read delete: any OS userland program linking cxxrt.o + libc++ that calls new(nothrow) (raw malloc payload) then delete has the same latent free(BLOCK_MAGIC) bug. Recommend: give cxxrt's new/delete the section attribute and make cxxrt delete call free(ptr).
